summary: The filing is a US Form 6-K for a routine annual general meeting. Wisekey International Holding AG provides standard agenda items: approval of annual report, discharge of board and management, re-election of board members, auditor and compensation committee, and advisory votes on compensation. No extraordinary items, activist proposals, M&A, capital returns, or delisting are mentioned. The meeting logistics and procedural details are typical for an ordinary AGM. This is not a special situation.
